title: NotAPullRequestError

anyOf.description: A forge origin: https, or http for a LAN or tailnet instance, then the host in lower case and a port only when it is not the scheme's default (https://git.example.com:5526); no userinfo, path or trailing slash.

origin.description: The origin the URL is on; null for a URL that names no forge.

description: The URL is no pull request's web address on a forge a provider reads (GitHub's /<owner>/<repository>/pull/<number>, Forgejo's and Gitea's /<owner>/<repository>/pulls/<number>, on the kind of the forge account serving its origin): nothing was linked. data names its origin, when it has one.
